```typescript
// Types
type Board = number[][];

// Top-level variables
let board: Board = [
  [0, 0, 0],
  [0, 0, 0],
  [0, 0, 0]
];

let score: number = 0;

// Functions
function renderBoard() {
  document.getElementById("board").innerHTML = board.map(row => row.join("<td>"))
}

function updateScore(scoreValue: number) {
  score += scoreValue;
}

function getComputerMove(): number {
  // Minimax implementation
  const bestMove = minimax(board, 0, false);
  return bestMove[0];
}

// Game loop
function gameLoop() {
  renderBoard();
  updateScore(1);
  getComputerMove();
}

// Start game
function startGame() {
  renderBoard();
  updateScore(0);
  gameLoop();
}

// Setup and start
const boardElement = document.getElementById("board");
const restartButton = document.createElement("button");

boardElement.addEventListener("click", () => {
  board.fill(0);
  updateScore(0);
  restartButton.textContent = "Restart";
  boardElement.appendChild(restartButton);
});

boardElement.appendChild(restartButton);

startGame();
```
